title: ECG arrhythmia classification on microcontroller-class wearables: code, weights, partition manifests and per-beat predictions
description:
Artefacts supporting the paper A Deep Learning ECG Arrhythmia Classifier for Microcontroller-Class Wearables: Inter-Patient Evaluation, External Validation and Embedded Deployment Analysis.

Contains the complete analysis pipeline, the FP32 weights of all seven arms at five seeds under both the inter-patient and the patient-mixed partition, the INT8 quantisation-aware-trained student and its CMSIS-NN deployment tensors, the exact record lists and per-beat manifests of every partition, the environment specification, the seeds, the per-beat posterior probabilities on DS2, the patient-mixed refit, INCART and SVDB, and the main and supplementary figures.

The raw waveforms are not redistributed: the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia, St Petersburg INCART, MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia and MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test databases are public on PhysioNet and are fetched by the download script.
